نبذة

At Rouge and Henna Beauty Saloon and Spa, the focus is on enhancing natural beauty through a variety of expertly delivered services. Clients can indulge in precise waxing for the upper lip, eyebrows, and full face, or treat themselves to a rejuvenating manicure and pedicure. The skilled team is dedicated to providing a serene and satisfying experience, ensuring every visit leaves you feeling refreshed and beautiful.

التعليقات

118

Rouge and Henna Beauty Saloon and Spa pairs a broad beauty menu with Moroccan-inspired treatments, including the classic Moroccan bath and massage. The stylists also handle haircuts and colouring, while the brow artists offer eyebrow threading; reviewers additionally mention henna and the Sudanese dalkah scrub.
